observed: Both NixOS VMs booted with eight vCPUs and 8 GiB each, and the VM-local trust fixture added its signature.
The initial molten-node.service active-state assertion timed out after 3600.58 seconds, before the signed integration and storage-denial assertions.
The test driver terminated both QEMU processes during cleanup. The four-hour aggregate driver deadline was not the failing bound.
Guest boot logs show the 9p driver and read-only store mount; they do not establish the startup timeout's root cause.
non_claims: No passing signed multinode result or observed storage-denial result.
No proof that CPU, memory, store transport or repeated admission caused the timeout.
No producer/operator independence, qualification of later source, or release authority.
